name: Pajo's Fish & Chips Restaurant
description: Since 1985, Pajo's Fish & Chips Restaurant has become a favourite among locals and tourists in Vancouver. Not only famous for fish & chips, each Pajo's location offers breathtaking views, including an iconic floating restaurant in Steveston, BC.

modules.content:
CHALLENGE

How to expand Pajo's Fish and Chips' branding from its digital marketing to restaurant environment?

SOLUTION

Create a recognisable look by repurposing social media template and graphic assets. This approach ensured a consistent brand identity in-store (signage, hot stamp, uniform, etc.). In addition, initiate new photography sessions to keep Pajos' content relevant.
